recommendation: usable opt-in normal-yard REVIEW candidate; owner final approval and real Mac admission/playback remain pending
recommendationScope: Positive suitability for optional review paint at this96px presentation, not final art acceptance, default resident activation, whole-species completeness or normal-yard playback certification.

appropriateUses: Integrity of the promised file/pixel lineage and reproducible export
An explicitly protected-body or fixed-body rig experiment that promises unchanged pixels
exactRGBAEquality.interpretation: A hand-drawn blink may redraw plumage, head, wing or toe pixels and still be visually coherent. Pixel differences neither automatically fail animation quality nor prove meaningful animation. Earlier preen protected-body controls can fail their stated preservation promise without implying all naturally drawn preening is unsuitable.

visualGates: Recognizable individual/species appearance and consistent plumage/proportions
Stable relative scale and stance at intended presentation size
No conspicuous toe sliding, gross body jump, distracting silhouette/color flicker or alpha field
Plausible dwell/blink/return sequence and loop boundary
Honest evidence/provenance and separated art, contract-admission and normal-yard playback gates
criteriaAudit.colorAlphaRestriction: Primary review is straight full RGBA nearest-only. No63-color or binary-alpha requirement is applied. Limited-palette/binary comparison is optional and was not used as the primary candidate.
criteriaAudit.thresholdPolicy: No unagreed native-source pixel tolerance is promoted to a universal semantic standard. Measurements support judgment at intended raster size, with unknown annotation uncertainty and rasterization treated explicitly.

visualSourceAssessment.sourceClassification: Previously registered source frames with atlas-crop/integer-registration lineage retained; not new generated originals for this experiment.
visualSourceAssessment.identity: Red crown/throat/chest, brown layered folded-wing pattern, cream/brown streaked underside, dark conical bill, long tail and two pink legs remain recognizably the same male finch across the three states. Broad proportions and orientation are consistent. This visual judgment is not a taxonomic expert certification.
visualSourceAssessment.actualPoseChange: Visible eye progresses from open to partly closed to closed; actual drawn lid/eye changes are present. It is not static-frame translation called new animation. Small head, feather, bill-edge and toe redraw differences also exist.
visualSourceAssessment.anatomyLimit: No obvious added limb, dramatic bill deformation or identity replacement is visible. Detailed toe anatomy, biological blink kinematics and anatomical contact labels remain unverified.

visual96Assessment.presentation: 96x96 untrimmed canvas at CSS96x96/devicePixelRatio1; alpha128 bird bounding box is only48–49px wide and38px tall.96px is canvas size, not bird body length or approved biological length.
visual96Assessment.normalSize: The bird remains legible as the same right-facing male finch. Open and closed eye states remain distinguishable at actual96px, although the intermediate half state is subtle.
visual96Assessment.relativeScale: No gross zoom or body-size jump is evident in the actual96px samples. Height and stance bounds remain fixed; approximately1px silhouette differences are local redraw/rasterization changes rather than per-frame fitting.
visual96Assessment.motionAndContact: Sampled states show a planted-looking stance without a visible rigid foot translation or vertical hop. Small toe/feather pixel changes remain; fixed alpha128 bounds and baseline support this interpretation but do not establish physical ground contact.
visual96Assessment.visibleFlicker: Minor feather, tail-edge and toe pixel redistribution is visible under4x inspection and when comparing states. No conspicuous whole-body color/shape flash or identity jump is apparent in the inspected96px chronological samples. Continuous-speed perception and yard-background judgment remain for owner/Mac review.
visual96Assessment.alpha: Full RGBA is retained. Light browser composite and dark in-memory composite show no conspicuous matte/halo field at96px. This is not a guarantee on every target background or renderer.
visual96Assessment.loop: Open frame is reused identically before and after blink. Decoded endpoint equality verifies no open-to-open boundary change. The useful semantic evidence is the observed open/half/closed/half/open progression; endpoint equality alone is not an animation-quality pass.

sourceVsRasterInterpretation.sourceFootHeuristic: Bottom28-source-pixel alpha128 split/median proxy, not anatomical tracking; uncertainty has not been quantified.
sourceVsRasterInterpretation.interpretation: Projecting a continuous source-space foot proxy does not predict exact96px alpha-threshold pixels. The2px median shift occurs within small10–13px raster foot masks whose bounds and per-foot lowest rows remain unchanged; it is not evidence of2px rigid-foot sliding. Raster contour differences are retained rather than hidden. Contact annotations and their anatomical uncertainty remain separate from this raster evidence.
sourceVsRasterInterpretation.declaredContacts: Same screen-space pixels[45,73] and[48,74] have positive alpha in every frame. This supports one technical review-manifest condition, not anatomical toe-center identity, true support geometry, depth/occlusion or approved biological scale.

timingAndDecodeEvidence.timingAssessment: Declared media timing is the exact rational30Hz schedule. Browser samples demonstrate the sequence renders at normal enabled APNG speed; screenshot/load scheduling does not independently certify frame-boundary times or the real Mac simulation scheduler.

browserSampleEvidence.renderMethod: Playwright page.set_content of exact retained HTML (fileURL navigation separately blocked)
browserSampleEvidence.timingSamplingMethod: actual browser APNG loaded from unique Blob URL containing exact embedded bytes; image-onload time origin, wall-time awaited then clipped96px screenshots; screenshot spans reported, no artificial phase stepping
browserSampleEvidence.samplingLimit: Headless Chromium rendered the actual media at normal speed and screenshot states were inspected chronologically. This is sampled actual browser playback, not continuous video perception or a human watching the whole loop. Screenshot capture spans are recorded separately; phase switches can occur inside a capture interval, and image-load/decode clocks need not equal first presentation time.

fileNavigationFailure.classification: Chromium local-file navigation policy; not a missing source asset
fileNavigationFailure.resolution: Supported page.set_content rendered the exact readable self-contained HTML; no network proxy, security-policy change, source mutation or Mac access.

browserSampleEvidence.clockTrialCaveat: An initial same-dataURL clone shared an existing APNG animation clock. Its relative phase timing was not used for schedule certification. Final retained samples use a unique Blob URL with identical embedded APNG bytes.

sampleContactSheet.purpose: Actual96px chronological browser screenshot samples plus static96px reference states. Stored within this review so no additional packet/source files were written.

contractAndAdmission.profileAuthority: Parent-reported current UI commit2e2f724f; this independent reviewer checked this packet rather than independently fetching current Mac source.
